# Contributing

Thank you for helping Wavefinity.

1. Fork the repository.
2. Make the change on a branch in your fork.
3. Open a pull request against `main`.
4. Explain what changed and why.

The repository owner reviews and approves every change before it can enter
`main`. Do not include passwords, API keys, personal files, or generated print
files. Follow the project rules in [README.md](../README.md).

AI Design uses [ai-features.md](../ai-features.md) as its reference. Any change that adds, removes, or alters a design option must update that reference in the same change. The embedded prompt and the reference must never disagree; if they do, the change is not finished.

By submitting a contribution, you agree that it is licensed under the project's
MIT License.
